summary: Iter210 — FRONTEND-only validation of taxi bidding negotiation (Gojek/V3Cube style) on /taxi-bidding. End-to-end test driven via Playwright (client UI) + backend REST (driver side, Bearer-token only, cookies cleared to avoid client/driver cookie collision). ALL 4 REQUIRED SCENARIOS PASS.

T1_no_route_summary_on_bidding.details: On /taxi-bidding?pickup=...&plat=...&dropoff=...&dlat=...&dlng=...&fare=15 the data-testid='route-summary' element COUNT=0. offer-fare-sheet=1, offer-fare-title='Offrez votre tarif', fare-input=1, fare-minus=1, fare-plus=1, find-driver-btn=1.

T2_driver_counter_offer_at_proposed_fare.details: Backend POST /api/rides/{id}/counter-offer with {amount:10, eta_min:5, distance_km:1.2} returned 200, payload includes at_proposed_fare:true and the offer object (off_05619654).

T3_client_offers_list_with_votre_tarif_b.details: Within ~5s of driver counter (2.5s polling), data-testid='driver-offers-list' rendered with offer-{id}, offer-name-{id} ('Chauffeur Demo' Peugeot 308), offer-your-fare-{id} ('Votre tarif' orange badge), Refuser (reject-offer-{id}) and Acceptez (accept-offer-{id}) buttons, plus rating 5.0, ETA 1 min, 0.00 km, and 25s countdown.

T4_reject_then_accept_flow.details: Refuser click → offer card disappears from list; ride GET shows status='pending', driver_id=null. Driver renews counter-offer → new offer-your-fare badge present. Acceptez click → navigation to /ride/ride_afdcfaa10c16; ride GET shows status='accepted', driver_id='driver_299321129b3d', fare honored at 10€ (the client's proposed fare).

critical_code_review_comments: Counter-offer endpoint accepts field name 'amount' (rides.py:2048). The review_request example uses 'counter_fare' — front-end client (driver IncomingRequestSheet) must send 'amount' (verified working in production via the driver UI; test used 'amount' successfully).
GET /api/rides?status=pending is the correct list endpoint; /api/rides/my-rides is NOT a route (matches /{ride_id} and returns 404 'Ride not found'). Not user-facing but worth documenting.

Auth uses HttpOnly cookies set by /api/auth/login (and overwritten by /api/auth/phone-login). Bearer-token header is honored ONLY when cookie is absent / cleared. For test rigs that drive 2 actors via REST, cookies must be cleared before Bearer-token driver calls.

Bidding screen auto-floors the fare query-param to fareFloor (?fare=15 was floored to 10€ when the computed estimate floor was 10€). UX is correct but the URL value is silently overridden — consider showing a small toast like 'Tarif minimum 10€ appliqué'.
Offer cards include offer-countdown without an offer-id suffix — duplicate rendering across multiple offers would yield duplicate testids. Recommend offer-countdown-{id}.

seed_data_creation: Cancelled any pre-existing pending bidding rides for the test client before test (cleanup). The final accepted test ride ride_afdcfaa10c16 remains in 'accepted' state (driver_id=driver_299321129b3d, fare=10€) — main agent may want to cancel via API if it pollutes demo dashboards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bidding negotiation flow on /taxi-bidding is GREEN end-to-end. Key invariants verified: (1) data-testid='route-summary' is ABSENT on bidding screen, (2) offer-your-fare-{id} 'Votre tarif' badge renders only for at_proposed_fare:true offers, (3) reject-offer-{id} hits POST /api/rides/{id}/reject-offer/{offer_id} and removes the offer card without changing ride status, (4) accept-offer-{id} hits POST /api/rides/{id}/accept-offer/{offer_id}, assigns driver_id, honors offer amount, and navigates to /ride/{id}. Driver-side counter-offer body uses 'amount' field (not 'counter_fare'). 2-actor tests must clear cookies before Bearer calls (HttpOnly cookie auth takes precedence).
